memory: I believe that maintaining a healthy work-life balance is crucial for success in finance. It's easy to get consumed by the demands of running an investment firm, but it's essential to prioritize family and relationships. My wife has been a constant source of support and encouragement, reminding me that time is the one asset that can't be compounded. I've learned to be present, both physically and mentally, and to engage with my kids rather than getting lost in emails. By making this effort, I've found that success in finance means nothing if I sacrifice the relationships that matter most.I believe that introducing financial literacy to children is crucial for their future success. By engaging them in interactive ways, such as setting up a small brokerage account or exploring real-world applications, I aim to instill a solid understanding of money management and the value of hard work. It's essential to strike a balance between providing financial security and fostering a healthy relationship with money. By instilling values like discipline and resilience, I hope to raise children who will make informed decisions and navigate life's challenges with confidence.I believe that the values instilled by my parents have been instrumental in shaping my approach to finance. My dad's experience running a small business taught me the importance of protecting financial security, while my mom's practicality has always reminded me to think long-term. Their influence has helped me develop a deep respect for financial discipline, which I strive to pass on to my own family. By ensuring that my parents have everything they need in retirement, I've been able to provide them with the security they deserve. It's a testament to the power of wealth when it brings peace of mind to those I love.I believe that having a sibling with a different perspective can be incredibly valuable in the financial industry. My younger sibling's immersion in the tech world brings a fresh and innovative approach to our conversations. By engaging in discussions about AI-driven fintech startups and sharing lessons on risk management, we challenge each other to think critically and stay ahead of the curve. The dynamic between us is built on mutual respect and a healthy competitiveness, which drives us to support each other's success. It's a rare and precious relationship that I cherish deeply.I believe that prioritizing family time is essential for maintaining a healthy work-life balance. By setting aside dedicated time for family and avoiding work-related activities during those moments, I ensure that I'm fully present and engaged with my loved ones. Blending business and leisure trips can be beneficial as well, allowing me to make the most of my time and create lasting memories with my family. Establishing a rule to align international deals with school breaks has been particularly effective in providing cultural experiences for my children while fulfilling my professional obligations. It's a delicate balance, but one that has worked well for us. Ultimately, my family serves as a grounding force, reminding me that wealth extends far beyond financial metrics and is truly about the relationships and experiences that bring joy to our lives.
